headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Officially Resigns As Vice President Of Indonesia
seoTitle: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns as Vice President
metaDescription: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally submitted his resignation to the MPR, leaving the position vacant as government operations continue.
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka formally submitted his resignation letter to the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) on Thursday.
Government officials and political parties have confirmed that administrative operations remain normal despite the current vacancy in the vice presidency.
Former President Joko Widodo stated he respects the decision while affirming his continued support for the current presidential administration.
aiContextParagraph: On November 12, 2026, Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned from his position as the Vice President of Indonesia. He submitted his formal resignation letter to the leadership of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) in Jakarta. Following the resignation, the MPR confirmed that the office of the vice president is now vacant. Despite the transition, the Head of the Communication Agency stated that national governance continues to function as usual. Former President Joko Widodo publicly addressed the event, describing political roles as temporary and reiterating his support for the administration of President Prabowo Subianto. Political entities such as the Gerindra Party have acknowledged the departure. As a result of the resignation, reports indicate that the departing official will continue to be entitled to specific state-provided facilities, while ongoing legal discussions regarding his documentation status have also drawn public attention.
whyItIsViral: The resignation of a sitting Vice President has triggered widespread media coverage and high public interest, reflected by a near-maximum viral score and rapid dissemination across major news outlets.
